caption: The video captures a low surface fire burning across the floor of a sunlit pine forest. A diagonal line of orange flames consumes dry grass and pine needles in the foreground, while straight tree trunks rise in front of an open field. Pale gray-white smoke lifts from the burning line and drifts upward, partly veiling the trunks. The flames flicker continuously, their tongues shifting in shape and height from moment to moment. The fire keeps feeding on the grass and needles along its line, while a small green tuft near the lower center of the frame remains unburned. A taller, brighter flame column swells near the center-right of the fire line and then subsides toward the lower profile. The low camera view drifts slightly, revealing more of the left foreground and a trunk at the far-left edge while the flame line stays roughly constant.
